note: The integration (ranker.decide) applies a ranker change only when the rule's confidence is under rule_trust, the ranker's margin is at least margin_min, the answer is allowed by the hard constraints (a swing arc is a door, a gap wider than its run is never a door, an end gap makes no element, closed and open are never the ranker's) and its transition (the weak rule -> the ranker's answer) is trusted in 'transitions': right on at least transition_precision of at least transition_min held-out changes of the leave-one-project-out run. Why (5 Nov 2026, the first model, before the trust check): the gates alone changed 26 decisions on the 28 readings, 21 of them on accepted real projects, and held out the ranker was right on 2 of its 8 changes on real projects; on real10 L0-L6 its window at the 1.50 m bedroom window gaps (the type is right: C0032) came before the later furniture rule that types the same window, which then left an extra opening beside it on seven floors. With the trust check: 5 changes (synthetic-12's four bare door gaps, one real07 gap). On the merged reader with the derived truth (6 Nov 2026) the margin is taken against every class (top_and_margin: real10's doorless mirror-axis gap had door 0.43, closed 0.29) and no transition is trusted, so the model changes no decision; it records its scores, its untrusted answers and the undecided places. The wall_or_notation model only advises (ranker_advice on the pair's record): held out it beats the rules by 0.004 and its integrated changes were right on 123 of 277; moving a pair into or out of the wall network is geometry.
